activity.subtitle: We’ve gathered a variety of psychological techniques in one place so you can find the ones that work best for you.
Each technique has a rating — choose the ones that help you the most.

coping.subtitle: Learn to gently reframe unhelpful attitudes.
Gradually replace unhelpful beliefs with more realistic and supportive ones using coping cards.

daybook.subtitle: Keep daily entries in a convenient format and express your thoughts freely.
The AI assistant will analyze your entries and help you see situations from a different perspective.

diary.subtitle: Tools to analyze automatic thoughts and replace them with more helpful and adaptive ones.
The journal is deeply integrated with AI to help you formulate and analyze your thoughts.
At every step, you’ll find clear explanations on how to use the journal effectively.

intermediate.subtitle: Go deeper and explore the roots of your experiences through intermediate beliefs.
Save unhelpful beliefs in coping cards and replace them with more rational and supportive ones.
Intermediate beliefs shape your automatic thoughts. Connect them to better understand your reactions and analyze them over time.
